title: Cloned Shorts styles make their videos
items: Fixed: a style cloned from a Shorts channel no longer blocks videos. Studio used to try writing an animation for it, which its Shorts never use, and when that failed the style said its videos wouldn't start. Now the study skips that step (less of your Claude usage), and the style's page says plainly that its Shorts are made by the recipe's own engine.

Fixed: Create shows the Shorts length for these styles. It used to show minutes, and the Short came out at the recipe's own length whatever you picked. Now you pick 15 to 60 seconds, like on the recipe itself.

Fixed: a study that can't download the channel's videos stops early. It says why (for example YouTube asking your computer to confirm it isn't a bot) instead of spending your Claude usage on an animation it can't write.

title: Finish a stopped 3D video without waiting for Claude
items: New: a 3D video stopped by your Claude limit can finish now. If a long 3D video stops in its picture review, its card offers Finish with the review so far: the review rounds already done keep their fixes, the shots Claude hasn't checked yet go to the final render as they are, and no more Claude goes on the review. Try again and carry on still works as before. It's your choice, for that video only.

title: Roblox Story Shorts tell the story you asked for
items: Fixed: Roblox Story Shorts no longer add timers nobody asked for. A timer, a number on the chest or a sign above the head now appears only when your topic states a rule like that ("In this town, everyone only has 1,000,000 steps"). Any other topic is told as a normal story.

title: Hindi, Fish Audio voices, video previews and your Claude use
items: New: make videos in Hindi. Pick Hindi in Create's Language: the script, the Gemini voice, the captions and the words on screen are all in Hindi, written in Devanagari with Studio's own font, and Roblox Story Shorts work in Hindi too.

New: Fish Audio voices on your own Fish Audio account. Paste your key in Setup and accounts, then pick your own cloned voices, a voice from Fish's library or any fish.audio voice link in Choose voice.

Recipes now play a few seconds of a real video when you hover them in Create, and your own styles play a few seconds of a video you made with them. Projects shows how much Claude Studio used today, this week and in total.
Thumbnails can be turned off in one click from Create's summary to save picture credits, and Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) is a new image model in Setup.
Fixed: vertical Shorts showed cropped to a wide band in Projects, and older clones of Shorts channels stayed 16:9. They now play whole and those clones switch to 9:16 by themselves.

title: Render in the cloud on your own Modal account
items: New: Studio Cloud on your own Modal account. Renders run off your computer, several at once, on Modal's machines and billed to your Modal account (Modal's free plan includes monthly credits). Studio isn't faster for one short video, but your computer stays free.

Setup has a step by step card: make a free Modal account, add a card only if you want 3D on a graphics card, create a token and paste both parts. The token stays on this computer and is never sent to ChannelRecipe.

In Create, choose Studio Cloud under Where it renders. The first cloud video sets up Studio's machines on your account once, which takes about 5 to 10 minutes. A 1 minute picture video takes about 8 minutes of machine time, about $0.10, and a 1 minute 3D video about 40 minutes on a graphics card, about $0.90.
Keep Studio open while a cloud video renders: the machine asks your own Claude Code for its directing steps, so they stay on your Claude plan.

title: New: the niche agent finds niches and video ideas with real outlier proof
items: New: the niche agent finds niches with real outlier proof. Ask Claude Code for /niche-agent (or just ask what you should make) and it finds faceless YouTube niches and video ideas with proof: small, new channels whose videos beat their subscriber count many times over, with a repeated formula, not a one-hit.

Every niche is checked live on YouTube and in ChannelRecipe's niche database: how young the channel is, its recent average views, its hits against its flops, and the look-alikes that are failing and why. AI slop niches are thrown out.

Each idea comes with its proof video, the twist that makes it yours and which ChannelRecipe recipe can make it. Save the ones you like: they appear under Saved ideas in Create, and Use fills in Create without starting anything.
It's free to run: it reads public YouTube pages and uses your own Claude Code plan. It keeps learning: new examples of good and bad niches from the ChannelRecipe team reach it without an update.

title: Videos come out the length you pick, and Roblox Story Shorts take your own recording
items: Fixed: videos made with a cloned style could come out about half the length you picked. Studio planned the script from the cloned channel's speaking pace, pauses and music included, while Studio's narrators read faster. It now plans each script at the pace your narrator really reads, measured on your own videos.

If a new script still comes out clearly shorter than the length you picked, Claude lengthens it once before the fact check, keeping every chapter and music line. Scripts you paste and scripts that already have a voice are never changed.

New: Roblox Story Shorts take your own narration. Choose Narration, My recording in Create and upload a take from 5 seconds to 3 minutes. Studio keeps it exactly as recorded, pitch and speed included, builds every shot around your words and ends the Short when your recording ends. No AI voice is made.
Create only offers My recording on recipes that can use it, and Resume no longer picks up a stopped video that was narrated a different way.

title: 3D videos carry on where they stopped, and style clones survive closing Studio
items: A 3D video stopped by your Claude usage limit now carries on where it stopped. Finished 3D review rounds, review answers and finished 3D clips are kept, so Try again and carry on doesn't spend your Claude usage on them again.

The stopped card says what stopped in one plain line per step, and the video's card shows how much Claude it has used so far, plus about how many 3D review calls are left. Long 3D videos get a note in Create about Claude Pro's 5 hour usage windows and the Quicker 3D review switch.
Closing Studio while a style is being cloned no longer loses it silently. The study says it stopped, no longer counts against your clones, and offers Study again with the same channels.

My styles now shows style studies in progress or stopped, and the bar on Clone a style says it counts the clones used on your plan. Keep the ChannelRecipe launcher window open while a study runs (closing the browser tab is fine).

title: Spanish and 12 more languages, Roblox Shorts with your own avatar, and fairer style studies
items: New: make videos in Spanish and 11 more languages. Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Indonesian and Tagalog too: pick the language per video on Create (or set a default), and the script, voice, captions and on-screen words follow it. Roblox Story Shorts speak every one of them.

New: Roblox Story Shorts wear your own avatar. They dress your main character from your avatar picture: Studio looks at it once and copies the hat, face, shirt, prints, pants and shoes. Other recipes now say plainly what a character picture does for them.

Style studies are fairer and say what really happened. A study that couldn't be scored says so instead of showing 0/10, and a style that missed the likeness check says it failed instead of "ready". The renderer follows your brief, dresses every scene for its era, uses a wider range of actions and shots, and re-plans when it starts repeating itself.
Use pictures instead now asks first and can be undone (Use Claude's animation again). When a channel looks partly 3D, Studio asks you 2D or 3D, and 3D styles are labelled 3D everywhere.
Styles learned from Shorts make vertical 9:16 videos on every route, with captions sized for phones.
Animated (coded) videos no longer open in a timeline that couldn't really edit them: Studio explains why and points you to Improve this style.

Fixes: Roblox Shorts on Windows say the real reason when Claude can't answer (it used to stop with "the director did not answer with a plan"); a full disk is named in setup instead of a browser reinstall that couldn't help; the download is called ChannelRecipe-111.zip.

title: Videos are made with Claude Code, and the full course is in Studio
items: Studio makes every video with Claude Code on your Claude plan, and the API account option is gone from setup. Still on the old route? Setup and Create show one button, Switch to Claude Code (recommended): it connects Claude Code, picks the models and checks them. Without Claude Code installed and signed in, it says that step first, and your videos keep working until you switch. Your saved key stays where it is.

Verify my Claude models is one press, and a check that stopped never blocks you again: press it and Studio runs a new one. Studio never reruns a stopped check by itself. The reason a check failed stays on screen, and an older Claude Code is told to update instead of being asked to sign in again.

New: the full course in Studio. Setup's Watch button plays the 11-minute course, a new account to a finished video, with chapters. The 3-minute setup video is one click away, and the sidebar links channelrecipe.com/course.

title: Coded channels look right, and Windows setup is smoother
items: Fixed: cloned channels drawn in code work on Windows. They stopped with "animation changed on disk" because Windows saves files with other line endings.

Coded videos draw the places, people and text the story needs. A clone's renderer draws any place (a bunker, a beach), keeps a recurring cast, fits its text and keeps crowds moving, and each stretch of the video is checked frame by frame and fixed once if something's off. The check adds a few minutes of your Claude plan per minute of video; switch it off in Create.
Setup on Windows is smoother. Windows no longer blocks Studio's downloaded files, installs are quieter, the graphics browser is a smaller download, and FFmpeg and Node install with one press each.
Cloning a coded channel is quicker and clearer. It skips a 12 to 20 minute graphics step, shows which video it's on and the time left, and suggests title ideas from the channel's own titles.
A cloned style keeps its own narrator, and you can pick a voice per style in Choose voice. Styles you cloned before keep the voice they always used.
Use pictures instead now says the graphics come from the base recipe, and offers to learn the channel's own graphics (about 7 to 20 minutes of your Claude plan, saved as a copy).
Long titles work on Windows, Create shows its problems one per line, and My script says how long the pasted script reads.

title: Improve a style from its page
items: New: improve a cloned style from its page. Say what to change and your Claude Code tries it (one call, a few minutes of your Claude plan); the current and the new version show side by side with their likeness scores, and nothing changes until you press Save the new version.

Your videos stay as they are. A video already being made keeps the version it started with, a newer version saved meanwhile is never overwritten, and a change Studio was closed in the middle of never blocks the style.
The page says when a change draws backgrounds for each video (about $0.02 each, up to six) before you save it.

title: Claude codes your channel's look, plus a queue
items: New: cloned channels are drawn by code your Claude Code writes. Every channel you clone, 3D and documentaries included, gets its own renderer written in code by default; AI pictures only if you choose them. If a clone falls short of the channel's own frames, improve it with Style Lab in Claude Code.

New: queue videos while one is being made. Add to queue starts each one by itself in turn, and when something stops them all (a Claude usage limit, an empty balance, a full disk) the queue waits on hold until you press Carry on.

New: a stopped video can be recovered with one clear yes. Studio says what stopped it and what carrying on may cost, and can carry on by itself after a usage limit resets if you tick that box. Making a video with the same title again offers Resume first.
New: setup installs FFmpeg, Node and Claude Code for you. One press each, checked against their published fingerprints, into Studio's own folder.
Faster 3D videos. Three Claude steps run at once, Create says how long 3D adds before you start, and Quicker 3D review takes one review round instead of several.
Cloned styles learn the channel's sound: its own music score and its own sound effects, made in code; no generic braams or bells unless the channel uses them.

Fixed: captions follow your switch, also when you resume a video. Research footage carries on through ChannelRecipe's watcher when Kie's isn't answering (at most 20 clip watches a video, never your credits), and archive.org outages are skipped.
Fixed: Quest videos show their game screen again, and 3D reviews run their repair round. The narrator no longer reads out sound cues left in a script.
Studio trusts your computer's own certificates, as your browser does. An antivirus web shield or a company firewall that checks secure connections no longer breaks downloads.
To fix setup for everyone, Studio tells ChannelRecipe which setup checks fail on your computer: only the check names, your Studio version and Mac or Windows.

title: Kie narrates with Gemini voices
items: Fixed: Kie narration uses Gemini voices only. Kie's ElevenLabs Turbo voice kept failing, so Kie now narrates with Google's Gemini voices, with free samples to listen to in Choose voice. ElevenLabs voices need your own ElevenLabs key.
Your voice carries over. A Kie ElevenLabs voice you chose is matched once to a similar Gemini voice, and Studio tells you so until you pick another.
One voice per video. A video stopped halfway through its narration is voiced again in Gemini when you resume it, which costs a few cents, so a video never mixes two voices.

title: Fewer stopped videos, plus Roblox Story Shorts
items: Fixed: a hiccup on the line to ChannelRecipe no longer stops a video. When an answer from ChannelRecipe gets lost on the way, Studio asks again for up to three minutes instead of stopping. Nothing is made or paid for twice.
New Shorts recipe: Roblox Story Shorts with blocky 3D characters. Stories where everyone wears the world's rule, with a twist, a fast narrator and one-word captions, for about $0.75 a Short.
Fixed: FOLIO videos work on Windows. Its long drawing rules now travel in a file, because Windows cut them short on the command line.
Fixed: one picture that can't be made no longer stops the whole video. The video carries on without it. AI presenters work again, and if a presenter still fails you can finish the video without it.
Fixed: style studies no longer stop right after their design steps. A long line in the study's rules made a Mac refuse it, and a long answer lost its start, so most failed clones ended there.
New: delete videos and learned styles. They wait in Studio's trash for 30 days, and Undo or Recently deleted brings them back. Claude Code always asks before deleting.
New: set exactly when each picture appears. The timeline editor's Timing panel snaps a picture's start and end to the words of the voice, with small nudges and a play button.

New: clone up to three channels into one style, Shorts channels too. You can now edit a style you learned, and before a paid clone Studio shows close styles you already have and can try about 5 seconds of one on your topic.

Fixed: Claude steps no longer run at a chat's extra-high effort. A Studio started from inside a Claude Code chat used to think much harder (and longer) at every step; now its steps use your normal settings, and the progress card names each 3D review round and why it takes a while.

Fixed: a video whose picture froze is repaired before it's published. Research footage also has a time limit per video, Studio keeps the computer awake while a video is made, and setup checks the disk your videos go on (about 4 GB free for a 10-minute video, 14 GB with 3D scenes).
When a video stops, Studio sends ChannelRecipe a short private note on why, so we can fix the cause. It never includes titles, scripts, names or file paths.

title: Claude writes your animated channel's animation
items: New: cloning an animated channel has Claude write its animation. During the study your Claude Code writes the channel's characters, moves, effects and places in code, draws test shots, compares them with the channel's own frames and improves them (2 to 4 drafts, usually 3 to 10 minutes of Claude usage).

Any drawn style, not just stick figures. Fight channels, animated short films and cartoon heroes each get an animation of their own, saved with the style and reused for every video: Claude directs the characters to the narration and Studio draws every frame on this computer.

Checked before you see it. Every video's animation is reviewed frame by frame before it is drawn, and if a channel's animation falls short of its own frames, the style's page says so and offers Use pictures instead.
Cheaper animated videos. A video costs its voice, plus a background picture for each place (about $0.02) only when the channel's animation asks for them.

title: Animated stick-figure channels, animated for real
items: New: clone a stick-figure animation channel and its characters really move. Studio rigs every character as a puppet in the channel's look and animates them in code: they walk, dash, punch, kick, block, power up and fire energy blasts, timed to the narration.

Each video designs its own cast from the script (hair, blindfolds, hats, markings, gloves, four arms) and draws a few backgrounds in the channel's look, about $0.08 a video. The fights come with hit sparks, auras, lightning, speed lines, impact frames and their own punch and blast sounds.
When you clone such a channel, keep Animated in the look's first question. The style's test shots are drawn by the animation kit, so checking the likeness costs nothing.

title: Studio on Windows: long folders, collages and more
items: Fixed for Windows: videos no longer stop at Windows' 260-character limit on file paths. Studio's own file names are much shorter now, so collages and Fast mode scenes fit, even with Studio in your Downloads folder.
New: setup warns when your Studio folder is too deep for Windows. It says how to fix it, and Create tells you before a video starts if its title is too long for that folder.

Fixed for Windows: captions with accented words (like café), Fast mode reusing its saved scenes, learned styles that keep working when you move your Studio folder, and a clear message when a second style study is started while one runs.
Every Studio release is now started and tested on Windows before it ships.

title: Style clones ask about animated characters
items: New: style clones ask about animated characters. When you clone a channel that animates its drawn characters (stick-figure fights, animated short films), Studio asks how your videos should be made, with its guess first.

Studio can't rig and animate 2D characters yet, so it says so before your study starts: your videos would be drawn pictures in their look, some moved as cut-outs or animated by AI. Nothing starts until you tick that you understand, or choose pictures yourself.
In Claude Code, the clone-style tools ask the same question and read you the same note before anything runs.

title: Uploads on slow connections, and antivirus blocks named
items: Fixed: uploads to Kie now survive slow connections. A big clip gets time for its size, a dropped upload is sent again (uploads cost nothing), and if it still can't finish Studio says why in plain words.
New: setup tells an antivirus block apart from a network block. It names the antivirus it finds running and says what to allow in it, step by step.
Fixed: setup answers in seconds when channelrecipe.com is out of reach. It used to wait a minute and a half.

title: Change a recipe's character for one video
items: New: give any story recipe a different main character. In Create, open Creative direction: Character now comes first, showing the recipe's own character.
Draw your own character from a description. Type who they are and press Draw this character: Studio draws them once in the recipe's style (one picture, about $0.02) and keeps them in every picture.
Or upload a picture of your character. It replaces the recipe's character in every picture of that video, and stays on your computer for the next one.
In Claude Code, ask for a different character. make_videos takes the character's description or the path of their picture.

title: Setup finds network problems before your first video
items: New: setup checks your network. It tries a quick secure connection to every service Studio uses and names any your network blocks, in plain words. Where Studio has a way around a block it says so and you can carry on; where it hasn't, it tells you what to do before a video starts.

New: the speech-timing model downloads during setup. A progress line shows how far it is, and Studio checks it loads on your computer once, so your first video no longer downloads it halfway through. A model that can't load shows in setup with a Fix it button.
Fixed: uploads to Kie work when your network blocks Kie's upload host. Studio sends those pictures and clips through channelrecipe.com instead.
New in Claude Code: its setup check covers the network and the speech model. Claude can also download the model for you.

title: Works on more networks, and says why when it stops
items: Fixed: Studio now gets Kie's finished files even when your network blocks Kie's file host. Voice, pictures, music and models then come through channelrecipe.com instead, for the rest of the day.
Fixed: when a video stops unexpectedly, Studio says why. The stop message names the cause and the last error, and Copy diagnostics now includes the video's own log.
Fixed: a clash between two copies of a maths library can no longer stop a video on Windows while it times the narration.

title: Updates never stop your work
items: Fixed: a new Studio no longer makes you update before you can carry on. Every Studio from the last few days keeps starting and resuming videos, so updating is your choice, when you're ready.
Fixed: a slow computer no longer stops a video at the Claude Code sign-in check. Studio now waits longer for Claude Code to answer and reuses a sign-in it confirmed recently.

title: Voice fixes
items: Fixed: some recipes could stop at their voice in Studio 94. A voice step called a part that had moved; it works again, and a check now stops that kind of slip before release.
Fixed: Voice it another way now shows whenever a narration fails. Before, a page opened before an update could miss it.

title: When a voice fails, voice it another way
items: New: a video whose voice failed can be voiced another way. Pick Gemini through Kie (same key), your own ElevenLabs account, or your own recording, and it carries on from where it stopped; your other videos keep Setup's voice.
New: Claude Code offers the same choice. When a voice service is down, Claude asks which way to carry on instead of only waiting.
New: your own recording, any time a voice fails. Read the script shown on the project, upload the recording, and the video is timed to your reading.

title: 3D and photo Shorts on Windows
items: Fixed: 3D and photo Shorts now start on Windows. They stopped at the script with "The system cannot find the file specified", because they couldn't find Claude Code there; they now find it the way the rest of Studio does.
Fixed: 3D Shorts on Windows now get their captions. The captions file's path broke at the drive letter.

title: Downloads that finish, whatever your connection
items: Fixed: the Shorts pack now downloads on connections that block our storage. Some internet providers cut every connection to it, so the first Short stopped; Studio now gets the same file through channelrecipe.com instead.
Fixed: a Shorts pack download that stops keeps what arrived. Resume carries on from there instead of starting the 400 MB again, and the project shows how far it got.
Fixed: a connection that keeps dropping still finishes. Studio keeps going while each try gets further, for the Shorts pack and for updates.

title: Smoother setup: a one-click fix for the graphics browser
items: Fixed: the graphics browser now has a one-click Fix it in Setup. Before, reopening the launcher never reinstalled it, so setup could keep saying it needed attention; Setup now also says why, and the launcher checks it on every start.
Fixed: two Windows setup bugs. The setup page could crash, and the graphics browser check could fail even when the browser worked.
New: Claude Code can fix the graphics browser for you. Open your Studio folder in Claude Code and ask it to finish setup.

title: Stopped videos stay in Projects, ready to resume
items: Fixed: a video that stopped (for example when a provider had a hiccup) vanished from Projects once Studio restarted or updated, so there was no way to press Resume. Stopped videos now stay in Projects under Needs attention: open one and press Resume saved project. Everything already made is reused.
In Claude Code, ask "resume my stopped video": Claude lists the videos that stopped, says why, and carries one on after you approve.

title: Claude Code knows your Studio from the very first chat
items: Fixed: in a freshly downloaded Studio, Claude Code didn't have Studio's tools until Studio had run once and you opened a new chat. The download now carries them, so even the first chat in the folder can make videos, clone styles and check setup.
Just say "let's make a video": Claude now uses /make-videos (and the other Studio commands) by itself. It still shows you the cost and asks before anything that spends money.
If you have two copies of Studio on one computer, Claude tells you which one is running instead of getting confused.

title: Make videos by just asking Claude Code
items: The setup page and START HERE now show the second way to use Studio: open Claude Code in your Studio folder and type /make-videos, /niche-strategy, /clone-style, /digital-product or /my-videos, or just say what you want.
Fixed: a video stopped by a passing Kie voice error now carries on when you press Resume saved project, even for videos that stopped before this update.

title: A passing Kie voice error no longer stops your video
items: Fixed: when Kie's voice service had a passing error ("Internal Error, Please try again later") and charged nothing for it, the whole video stopped, and Resume saved project stopped again straight away. Studio now tries that part of the voice again twice, a little later, and if Kie is still down, Resume tries again once you press it.
Nothing that was charged, refused or uncertain is ever sent again by itself.

title: Find your niche and build your product from Claude Code
items: New: /niche-strategy in Claude Code. It reads ChannelRecipe's live niche database and gives you channel ideas built on cross-niche arbitrage: a winning format bent toward a new audience, an open lane in a hot niche, or two channels combined, each with the evidence, the first five titles and a product idea.
New: combine two or three YouTube channels into one new style. Studio studies videos from each and learns one look from all of them.

New: /digital-product. Get product ideas for a niche before you even start (checked against what 140+ channels sell, with channel names and free domains), then build the book, its landing page and checkout from Claude Code.
In testing with the ChannelRecipe team: the style gallery and Claude Code show every style Studio Cloud can render, including your own clones.

title: Studio Cloud renders your cloned styles too
items: In testing with the ChannelRecipe team: your cloned styles and ChannelRecipe's own recipes can now render on Studio Cloud, and come out the way they do here. Shorts and recaps made from your own panels still render on this computer.

title: Make videos from Claude Code
items: New: Claude Code in your Studio folder can now make your videos. Type /make-videos (or just ask): Claude shows a gallery of your styles to pick from, tells you what it costs on this computer or on Studio Cloud, and starts once you agree.
New: /clone-style clones a style from a YouTube channel. /cloud-batch makes up to 5 videos at once on Studio Cloud, and /my-videos shows what is being made and plays your finished videos.
New: a desktop notification when something is done. It covers videos, cloud renders and style studies.
Claude Code always asks you before anything that spends money, and never reads your keys.

title: Footage searches no longer stall on a stuck video
items: Fixed: when Kie's video watcher stopped answering, Studio waited up to 15 minutes a try (three tries) on a single video, so a footage search could stall for most of an hour. It now moves on after five minutes; a working watch takes well under a minute.

title: Stopping a cloud render frees Studio straight away
items: Fixed: after you stopped a Studio Cloud render, Studio could stay busy for hours waiting for the stopped machine to report back, so no new video or update could start. It now frees up as soon as the machine stops.

title: Studio Cloud renders 3D videos on a graphics card
items: In testing with the ChannelRecipe team: 3D videos can now render on Studio Cloud. Their 3D scenes render on a cloud machine with an NVIDIA graphics card, the rest of the video the same way as any cloud render.

title: Studio Cloud renders the way your Studio does
items: In testing with the ChannelRecipe team: a cloud render now uses the same picture, voice, sound and footage-watching choices as your Studio (never your account key), so it comes out like a video made here.
Studio Cloud takes up to 5 titles at once and renders them side by side.
The summary under Create says Studio Cloud when you choose it, and the cloud renders list shows each video's title.

title: Designed 3D characters, rebuilt in 3D
items: New: designed 3D characters, rebuilt in 3D. Style clones of channels whose characters are designed, like round black heads with cute faces on stick-figure bodies, are now rebuilt in Studio's 3D engine: the channel's kind of heads, face marks, jackets, stick legs and gloves, in its kind of sets (rooms, streets, downtown, a running track or a park). They walk, run, point, check their phones and react, their faces change expression on the words, and the words on eye charts, signs, posters and screens are readable.

New: the clone checks itself with 3D test shots. It writes down the channel's cast (each recurring character's outfit and colours), renders test shots with the 3D engine and compares them with the channel, with no picture costs.

Changed: other designed characters are still drawn for now. Channels whose characters are another kind of design (blocky game avatars, clay, chibi or realistic faces) still have their scenes drawn in their look, and Studio says so before anything is paid.

title: Studio Cloud: choose where each video renders
items: New, in testing with the ChannelRecipe team: under Create, choose This computer or Studio Cloud. With Studio Cloud the script, voice and pictures are still made here with your Claude Code, then a ChannelRecipe machine renders the video, paid from your Studio Cloud balance. Projects shows your cloud renders with Download and Save to Projects.
Studio Cloud starts from the official Studio release and uploads only your own files (your styles and edits), a few MB instead of the whole Studio.
YouTube footage for a cloud render is downloaded on your own connection, the same way as at home, and only the clips it needs travel to the cloud machine.

title: Groundwork for rendering in the cloud
items: New, in testing with the ChannelRecipe team: Studio Cloud. The script, voice and pictures are made on your computer with your Claude Code as always, then a ChannelRecipe machine renders the video, paid from a small prepaid balance. It opens to everyone once it has passed its tests; until then nothing changes for you.
Fixed: stopping the render farm, or collecting and deleting its finished videos, now works while it is still running.

title: Downloads that work on every connection
items: Fixed: Studio downloads on connections that can't reach our file storage. Some internet providers couldn't find our storage address, so the download page showed "This site can't be reached". The download now comes through channelrecipe.com, and updates and the Shorts pack switch to it automatically when needed.

title: Style clones say exactly what your videos will be
items: New: Studio asks how a 3D channel's 3D is made. When a channel is mostly 3D, you pick animated characters with faces, faceless figures, or objects and maps, with Studio's guess first. Your answer decides how your videos are made.

New: Studio says plainly what your videos will be. If it can't make the channel's kind of video yet, such as 3D characters that walk and act, it tells you what it would make instead and starts only when you tick that you understand.

title: Updates that finish on a slow connection
items: Fixed: on a slow connection an update could stop with "the download kept getting interrupted". Studio now picks up where it stopped with a fresh download link, waits a moment between tries, and no longer starts the whole download again.

title: Every 3D look cloned the right way
items: Improved: when Studio watches a 3D channel, it now checks whether its characters are faceless figures or a designed cast with faces of their own, and picks how to make them from what it saw. Channels with dot-eyed, sphere-headed, avatar, clay or cartoon characters are drawn in their own look; faceless reconstruction channels keep Studio's 3D engine.
Fixed: a look that mentioned "small white" anything was treated as an all-white 3D world.

Improved: Studio checks your Mac has enough free disk space and memory before a style study starts, instead of stopping after the study's Claude work. Starting again after a stop keeps the look Studio saw and your answers.

title: Style clones that look like the channel
items: Improved: 3D channels with their own designed characters clone properly. Clones of channels with round heads, cute faces or a cartoon cast now draw every scene in that exact 3D look instead of Studio's faceless 3D mannequins. Reconstruction channels with faceless figures stay on the 3D engine.

New: every clone that draws its pictures is checked for likeness. Right after it saves, Studio draws test pictures in the new style (about $0.14), compares them with the channel's own frames, fixes what differs once, and shows you how close it came.

title: Edit countdown, polished
items: Fixed: Edit countdown fits a phone screen, and clips you did not touch keep their labels when you swap another.

title: Edit a finished Ranking Short
items: New: edit a finished Ranking Short. Open it from Projects and press Edit countdown: change any narrator line (or pick one of the other takes), swap any clip for the next best one Studio found, and remake it. Only what you changed is redone.

title: Ranking Shorts that know what is viral right now
items: New: Ranking Shorts find what is viral right now. Before searching, Studio watches the top ranking Shorts on your topic and finds fresh clips like theirs, so robot fails means this year's humanoid robots, not a decade-old lab clip.
New: make it like this Short. Paste a viral Short's link under Ranking and Studio remakes it with fresh clips of the same kind.
Improved: no more other channels' rank lists. Clips from other ranking Shorts are left out, so their rank lists never show over yours.

title: Pick your narrator from your ElevenLabs library
items: New: pick your narrator from your ElevenLabs library. With ElevenLabs connected, Create → Choose voice opens your own voices and ElevenLabs' whole library. Press ▶ to hear any voice for free, then Use to keep it for that recipe, Ranking Shorts included.

Fixed: with ElevenLabs connected, Create no longer stops on a missing voiceover key or asks you to connect a voice account. Ranking Shorts use ElevenLabs straight away; other recipes use the voice you choose for them.

title: Queue 15 Ranking Shorts, clips from TikTok, and a new Clip Board
items: New: queue up to 15 Ranking Shorts at once. Put one topic per line in Create several videos and Studio makes them one after another. If your clip watches run out or YouTube or Claude asks Studio to slow down, the rest wait on hold with nothing spent, and Carry on picks them up. Closing Studio keeps them too.
New: clips from TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Ranking Shorts now search TikTok and YouTube Shorts as well as long videos, through your ChannelRecipe account, with no extra keys.
New: the Clip Board is rebuilt inside Studio. Every clip is a card that plays its moment when you hover, with a Stop button for a search and a saved copy of each countdown you make.
Improved: clips start and end between words. When someone talks or screams straight through, the clip lets the scream finish or fades out softly instead of cutting a word in half.
Improved: Shorts that hit a limit (clip watches, YouTube, Claude) stop with a plain reason and carry on where they left off when you make them again, without paying twice.
Improved: the narrator stays quiet while someone in a clip is talking, shouting, barking or meowing, so it never talks over the joke.
Improved: topics in Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian and Dutch keep their own words in the title.
Changed: Remove burned-in text is now off by default because it takes a little longer. Turn it on for clips with captions or watermarks.

title: Cleaner, consistent Ranking Shorts and an easier setup
items: Improved: every clip in a Ranking Short now plays in the same window under the title, so long-form clips, Shorts and re-uploads look like one video. Re-uploads are cut down to their real footage: no tweet frames, blurred copies or borders.
New: burned-in captions, watermarks and banners are taken off clips for free on your computer. Turn it off with the Clean clips switch.
Improved: the window follows the faces in each clip, so both people in a reaction stay in shot.
Improved: the narrator uses ElevenLabs v4 when you connect your own ElevenLabs account, and lines never talk over the clip's own dialogue.
New: Setup lets you pick the narration voice in step 3. Paste an ElevenLabs key and Studio reads a line so you can hear it.
New: stuck on setup? Press Watch the whole setup on the Setup page for a three-minute walkthrough with chapters.
Good to know: this update installs a small text finder, and the first clip it cleans downloads a 208 MB model once.

title: A new-look Clip Board, and TikTok links
items: New look: the Clip Board is redesigned. Every clip is a card that plays its moment when you hover, with a score ring and its views; tap to pick it, and your countdown builds in a dock at the bottom with #1 in gold. Drag the slots to reorder.
New: paste links on the Clip Board. TikTok, Instagram and YouTube links become cards like the clips Studio found, watched for their best moment.
Improved: Ranking Shorts skip cartoons, games and movie scenes unless your topic asks for them, so a funny-animals countdown stays real footage.
Good to know: this update installs a small library that lets Studio download TikTok clips. It happens by itself when Studio restarts.

title: Ranking Shorts: viral clips counted down to #1, found for you
items: New: Ranking Shorts, a Shorts recipe for the format with hundreds of millions of views. Type what to rank (Funniest Dog Moments, Best Shark Moments) and Studio searches YouTube for viral clips, watches every one for its best moment, picks and trims them the way the top ranking channels cut, and counts them down to #1.

New: the Clip Board. Prefer to choose? Open it from the Ranking Shorts options: every moment Studio found appears as a card with its score, plays when you hover over it, and you tick the ones you want and drag them into order. Drop in your own clips too.
New: a punchy narrator. Every clip gets a short setup or punchline written for it, read by ElevenLabs v3 when you have an ElevenLabs key (Gemini otherwise).
New: sound design learned from 260 viral ranking Shorts: vine booms where the joke lands, a punch-in on faces, and meme sound effects from a library of 362 named sounds.

Good to know: finding clips uses your plan's monthly clip watches (about 30 a Short). Creator includes 300 a month, Pro 900 and Max 2,400. If you run out, you can switch on "Use credits" and each further watch costs 0.02 credits.

title: Shorts: make vertical Shorts from a topic, in 3D or photo style
items: New: A Shorts tab in Create. Pick a Shorts recipe, type a topic and choose a length from 15 to 60 seconds. Studio writes the script, voices it, scores it with its own music and sound effects, and delivers a finished 9:16 Short with captions.

New: 3D Explainer Shorts. A narrator explains a weird fact, a how-to or a what-if while realistic 3D people act it out in sets built for your story, shot like a film. Animals, sea creatures and dinosaurs are built for the story too, on land or under the sea.
New: 3D Dark Stories. True crime and horror in the same 3D style. For a real case, Studio researches it on the web first, the script uses only checked facts, and the sources go into your description.
New: Photo Comedy Shorts. A fast photo-collage comedy Short with a host, scene photos made for every line and punchy sound design.
New: Explainer Shorts check their facts on the web before the script is written, so every number in the narration is real.
Good to know: the first Short downloads the Shorts pack once (about 400 MB). Shorts use your Claude subscription and your Kie key, like your other videos.

title: Studio tells you when your video is ready, and opens instantly
items: New: The browser tab shows what Studio is doing: "Making" and your title with a violet dot while it works, and "Ready" with a green dot when a video finishes while you're in another tab. Press "Notify me when it's ready" for a desktop notification too.
New: Studio has its own tab icon.
Improved: Studio opens instantly. It shows your last account check straight away and refreshes it in the background.

Fixed: Real-footage search no longer stalls on a slow connection ("Connection aborted ... write operation timed out" for every video). The clips sent to the video watcher are about a tenth of the size, a stalled upload gives up after two minutes, and after three failures in a row the search carries on without the watcher.

Improved: From this release on, the previous Studio can still start new videos after an update comes out. When an update is needed, Create says to press Update now (it keeps your projects), and the update banner stays until you do.
Improved: Project pictures show the story instead of a dark first frame.
Improved: The style library lists each style once; style studies appear while they run.

title: Ready-made recipes, Studio colour 3D and your own call to action
items: New: Five ready-made recipes learned from top channels and tested end to end: Stick Figure Stories, Hand-Drawn Money, Clean 3D Reconstruction, Deadly Places Documentary and Manga Recaps.
New: Whiteboard styles draw every picture on: a hand with a marker traces the lines, you hear the marker, then the colour comes in.

New: Manga Recaps uses your own panels. Upload pictures or a .zip or .cbz; long webtoon strips are cut into panels and page margins trimmed for you. Studio reads them, writes the recap and shows each panel on the words that tell it, with no picture costs.

New: A call to action in any video. Say what you promote and its link, add a cover or screenshot and choose one to three mentions. The narrator mentions it after the first three minutes, a card with a QR code appears as they say it, and the description opens with your link.
New: Add your own presenter. Upload a photo, name them and choose their voice; they talk to camera lip-synced and appear in the pictures doing what is said.
New: The sound of each place. Learned styles whose channels use ambience lay rain, wind, a crowd or a quiet room under the pictures that show those places.
New: Choose how many pictures a minute a story recipe draws, down to a floor that keeps each picture on its own words.
New: Choose each video's 3D look: a clean white studio, Studio colour (the same clean models painted in your palette, ivory with signal yellow unless you pick another) or colour film.
Improved: Learned picture styles draw what the narrator explains, not mood pictures: the money leaving a bank, the gap between two numbers. Story styles draw the moment being told.
Improved: Pictures never carry an invented caption, date, place name or archive label; only the words the scene itself names.

Improved: Style cloning matches channels more closely: their real share of footage, their film finish, how loud their music sits even when it comes and goes, a cold open on a real clip, presenter screen time, hand-drawn and comic lettering, recurring characters, and channels that hold their pictures still.

Improved: Real footage fails far less often. Studio asks YouTube gently and over IPv4 when your connection has it, and when YouTube refuses, the video says why and what fixes it. Real-photo searches no longer pick other channels' thumbnails.
Improved: Photo styles look like real phone pictures instead of glossy AI images, and people are never drawn as a lone hand reaching into the frame.
Improved: Documentary chapter cards hold their title while the new section begins, with no film burn unless the channel uses one.
Improved: Studies references up to 24 hours long, retries a failed download, and tells you when part of a reference couldn't be measured.
Improved: "I'll upload my own" host or mascot now asks for your character after you choose a sample.
Fixed: Presenter recipes on a Kie account no longer stop with "needs its original service"; the presenter speaks through Kling.
Fixed: In stories with moving pictures every picture now appears on its own sentence; it used to arrive one sentence early, and the moving pictures were missing.
Improved: A style study that stops now says why, and you can start it again right there.

Fixed: On Windows, a video no longer stops when Studio reads its progress at the same moment ("PermissionError [WinError 5]"). If Studio is closed while it makes a video, it tells you so the next time it starts.
Fixed: A long Claude Code answer, such as the 3D review of a long video, comes back whole instead of being cut off.
Fixed: A network blip before a picture or clip request is sent no longer stops the video, and a refused request says which error code it was.
Fixed: When the footage search service is down, Studio stops asking it after a few tries instead of waiting most of an hour.

title: Style learning that sees the whole channel
items: New: Style cloning looks before it learns. Studio measures a few minutes of each video (cuts, motion, colour, music and sound effects) and ChannelRecipe's Gemini watches them, then shows what it saw: the recipe it recommends, every setting with its reason, and the cost per minute. Nothing runs on your Claude or picture accounts until you continue.

New: Learned styles keep the channel's own look instead of the starting recipe's: picture style, how people are drawn, pace, camera moves, colour, captions, music level, sound effects and narrator, with a script voice written for the channel.

New: Choose the picture style every video keeps. After a study, Studio draws three sample pictures in the learned style; the one you pick is copied by every picture, and a channel host gets a character sheet.
New: Music written for each video. Styles whose channels use music get one cue per section, made for that video in the channel's own sound on your Kie account (about 6 cents a section).
New: Recorded sound effects (whooshes, hits, risers, paper, marker, coins) for learned styles, placed on the actions your pictures show.
Improved: Learned styles draw with Nano Banana 2.1, which keeps the style and draws whole people, at the same price per picture. A picture model you chose in Setup still comes first.
Improved: Pictures are made four at a time, so a video's pictures finish sooner.
Improved: Moving pictures copy the same style drawing as the stills.
Improved: What's new marks each change as new, improved or fixed.
Fixed: Studio re-runs its daily Claude model check by itself instead of sending you back to setup.

title: Steadier writing with API accounts
items: Fixed: videos using an API account could lose parts of their research with "The brain is busy", "could not answer" or "This request stopped". Studio now queues its requests and waits patiently, and a request is never paid for twice.
When your AI account is rate limited, Studio waits and tries again instead of stopping.

title: Every option for learned styles
items: Styles you learn in Mixed media now offer every option in Create (sound design, motion graphics, maps, footage and more), not just the few their starting recipe had. Your styles' current choices stay as they were.
The style study page explains the two Video look modes and which channels each suits.

title: Easier to get help
items: Copy diagnostics: one button on the setup page and in the sidebar copies everything support needs (never your keys). Paste it in Discord #help.
The Studio window now says clearly that Studio is running, and no longer fills up with page requests.
Opening Studio twice just brings up the one that's already running.

title: Always opens the right screen
items: Fixed: if Studio was started a different way (for example by Claude Code running the engine directly), it opened an older screen without setup. Studio now always opens its own setup and workspace.

title: Style learning on Macs with less free space
items: Fixed: on a Mac with under 20 GB of free disk space, learning a style stopped near the end. It now needs about 3 GB.
Fixed: Level-Up Stories could wait forever on a Mac with little free disk space.
Voice previews play instantly, at no cost to your account.

title: Style learning fixed
items: Fixed: previewing a YouTube channel to learn its style failed with "The study could not complete this step".

title: Choose your narration voice
items: Pick from 70 Gemini voices right on the Create page: press Choose voice in Narration & sound.
Hear a short preview of any voice before you choose it. Search by name or by style, like warm, deep or clear.

title: Faster thumbnails and one-click updates
items: Recipe thumbnails load much faster and stay cached.
Learning a style from a YouTube channel works on more computers, and says exactly why when YouTube refuses a link.
Update Studio from inside Studio. It downloads only what changed and restarts in a few seconds.
See what's new before you update. Updating is always your choice; your current version keeps working.

title: Easier setup
items: Connect your ChannelRecipe account with one click. No key to copy.
Setup is three steps with one button each, and every button shows when it's working.
Set up Claude for videos in one click.

title: Windows fix
items: Fixed: on some Windows computers the recipe list didn't load.

title: Fast mode fixed
items: Fixed: Fast mode (quick 3D graphics) couldn't finish its setup. Its setup button now sits right next to the switch.

title: New look
items: The new ChannelRecipe logo.

title: Recipe previews
items: Every recipe shows a style reference, so you can see the look before you pick it.
Recipe names that say what they make, like True Crime Case Files and Dark History 3D.
